remark: Added a try-catch around stream.close() to catch RuntimeException (including NullPointerException and other unchecked exceptions), ensuring the loop does not abort prematurely.
analysis: The code iterates over an array of BaseStream objects and calls close() on each. The close() method may throw RuntimeExceptions (e.g., NullPointerException if a stream is null, or IllegalStateException from the implementation). Without exception handling, any runtime exception thrown by a single stream.close() will terminate the entire loop, preventing remaining streams from being closed. To ensure all streams are attempted to be closed even if one fails, we should catch RuntimeExceptions inside the loop.
